classification_reason: The wrong note was found in one search and corrected through an approved, append-only, receipted revision, with the original sentence intact; the documented supersession path was unavailable because no capability creates a note.

consumer.goal: Record that the A27 skewed-join measurement shows an earlier note wrong, so future reads see the correction, without destroying the original wording.

commands: validate; baseline; generate; grep original sentence
confusions: WORKFLOWS §15 prefers a superseding note (state: deprecated + supersedes) over editing, but no capability creates a new note, so supersession cannot be done through the gateway. The note is also only partly wrong (one summary line), so deprecating the whole note would itself mislead.
note.evidence.add wants a typed URI ref (material://, note://, https://); there is no documented URI for a stage working note, so I did not attach the measurement as evidence.
questions_asked_to_learner: Proposed: (1) file A27 verbatim in the working note of stage-df-joins-01-strategies; (2) append a dated 'Correction' section to note-hash-join-vs-sort-merge, directly below your unchanged summary line, quoting your measurement's conclusion. Approve? → 'Yes, apply exactly that.'
consumer.outcome: The wrong note is note-hash-join-vs-sort-merge. Its original summary line ('hash join is always O(n + m), so it wins whenever there is no sort order to exploit') is unchanged at line 26, and a dated Correction section directly below it quotes the measurement: O(n + m) holds only if build partitions fit in memory and keys are spread out. The measurement itself sits in the joins stage note. Validation 0 errors.

internal.approval_behavior: operator-approval over the intent hash; the replacement file bound by SHA-256; both after the scripted approval.

No URI scheme is documented for stage working notes, so the measurement cannot be attached as note evidence.
